title: GuardInventory
description: The G00 (#753) inventory of this repo's enforcement surface: every hook registration, every guard module, and every `do-not.md` invariant, each carrying a SEMANTIC id, an owner, its current surface, its target disposition and its evidence. Everything in the G00-G12 function-hooks programme rests on this. WHY THE CLOSED SETS ARE GENERATED: the report this inventory replaces derived its guard-module list from `ls python/src/kb_setup/ | grep -Ei 'guard|hook|check_first|absent|stage|instruction'`, which bounds the NAME — four guard modules contain none of those tokens (`graph_first`, `destructive_git`, `codex_lane`, `inplace_edit`) and were invisible while sitting in the live dispatch tuple at `hook_guard.py:295-309`, one of them for a month. It published 7 modules / 2,859 lines; the true figures are 11 / 4,024. An inventory whose membership rule is a name pattern reproduces exactly that defect, so `reconcile` enumerates by REACHABILITY. NO COUNTS ARE STORED HERE — 21, 11, 15 and the 28-case denominator are always derived, because a stored census drifts in lockstep with itself and reads green forever.

SemanticId.title: SemanticId
SemanticId.$comment: A readable, dotted, semantic identity — `hook.pretool.instruction-edit.claude-md.edit`, `module.graph-first`, `do-not.default-branch`. NEVER an array index and NEVER a hash. An index changes when anything is inserted above it, silently re-pointing an approved disposition at a different rule; a hash changes when the object is legitimately edited, forcing re-review of something that did not change meaning. This pattern rejects both: `R00` fails it (no dot), and a hex digest fails it (leading digit in a segment is allowed but a bare 64-char hex has no dots).

OwnerKind.title: OwnerKind
OwnerKind.description: Who can change the thing — which decides whether a disposition is …
OwnerKind.$comment: Who can change the thing — which decides whether a disposition is even actionable from this repo. external-tool and claude-code-runtime items cannot be migrated by editing `python/src/kb_setup/`, so a `function-hook` disposition on one is a contradiction the reconciler rejects rather than a plan. Kept SEPARATE from Disposition deliberately: folding ownership into the target enum is what made the first cut of this schema unable to distinguish 'outside our control' from 'already done'.

CurrentSurface.title: CurrentSurface
CurrentSurface.description: Where enforcement lives TODAY. Separate from Disposition, which is …
CurrentSurface.$comment: Where enforcement lives TODAY. Separate from Disposition, which is where it is going. This axis exists because 'must add' versus 'must retain' is DERIVED from current_surface vs disposition, and encoding that derivation as extra enum values is redundant and ambiguous. A single enum carrying current state AND target AND ownership leaves downstream code unable to tell 'already there' from 'must migrate' from 'not ours' — the inventory then looks exhaustive while giving an executor no unambiguous action. non-hook-control: a build/stage/runtime/ship control (an hk step, `clean_env()`, `pr.py`'s ship preflight). prose-only: written down, nothing enforces it.

Disposition.title: Disposition
Disposition.$comment: Ray, 2026-09-11: 'would like to move as much out of do-not.md into function hooks so it is enforce vs just suggested' — these are the honest answers to 'and what happens to this one?', including the answers that are not 'migrate'. Generated rather than a bare `str` because THIS REPO HAS ALREADY PAID FOR THAT: `ReviewedClassification` was a bare `str`, its consumer dispatched with `if`s and no `else`, and an unrecognised value was silently dropped while the entry still looked reviewed — two full `kb-build` runs to find. A seventh target must fail schema validation until the schema, the generated enum and every consumer are deliberately updated, which is that lesson working in the right direction. VALUES. function-hook: intended to be enforced by an in-process function hook; for a classic registration this INCLUDES eventually removing that registration. 🔴 A function-hook row is an INTENT, never a claim the runtime supports it — G01 proves that. classic-hook: a repo-owned classic hook deliberately RETAINED because its event semantics have no function-hook equivalent (a SessionStart/SessionEnd lifecycle hook has no tool call to intercept); requires a rationale. external-classic-hook: invokes externally-owned hook machinery this repo retains rather than ports — the two `.venv/bin/graphify hook-guard` registrations; omitting this value silently drops 2 of the 12 PreToolUse entries. non-hook-control: the right carrier is a build/stage/runtime/ship control, not an agent hook. prose-only: no reliable mechanical decision exists; REQUIRES an explanation of why intent cannot be inferred from a call. support-module: a python module stays supporting implementation rather than becoming an enforcement registration — the honest home for a shared tokenizer.

EvidenceKind.title: EvidenceKind
EvidenceKind.description: What KIND of evidence backs this row, so a reader can tell a measured …
EvidenceKind.$comment: What KIND of evidence backs this row, so a reader can tell a measured claim from a read one without re-deriving it. inherited-unverified lets an un-re-derived figure be CARRIED rather than silently promoted to a measurement (`probes-need-a-control-arm.md` rule 6). The reconciler does not reject it; it reports the count, so the inventory's own confidence is visible.

ReachedBy.title: ReachedBy
ReachedBy.description: HOW a registration reaches a module — the membership test itself.

InvariantKind.title: InvariantKind
InvariantKind.description: The numbered `do-not.md` entries, and the non-'See also' `##` …
InvariantKind.$comment: The numbered `do-not.md` entries, and the non-'See also' `##` subsections.

ScopeCase.title: ScopeCase
ScopeCase.description: ONE effective enforcement case: a single tool, optionally narrowed to …
ScopeCase.$comment: ONE effective enforcement case: a single tool, optionally narrowed to a path scope. This is the real coverage denominator. Expanding every matcher alternative and refining `Edit|Write` through its `if` gives 28 effective cases across 18 registrations — so a migration graded against 18 can drop 10 cases and still read complete. That is the programme's own failure mode #8, 'raw registration counts are not the denominator', as an arithmetic fact.

RegistrationSource.title: RegistrationSource
RegistrationSource.description: The LIVE identity this row binds to.
RegistrationSource.$comment: The reconciler matches on (event, matcher, condition, command) and NOT on the row's id, so renumbering or reordering cannot re-point a disposition. `reviewed_timeout_seconds` is deliberately OUTSIDE that key: including it would make a timeout change fabricate an ORPHAN plus an UNCLASSIFIED for what is one hook, so it is compared as a reviewed ATTRIBUTE instead.

owner_ref.description: The module or binary that actually implements it.

module_ids.$comment: MANY, not one: `kb-setup hookguard` is a single registration dispatching to nine modules. A 1:1 assumption here cannot express the real surface.

rationale.description: REQUIRED in spirit for classic-hook and prose-only dispositions: a …
rationale.$comment: REQUIRED in spirit for classic-hook and prose-only dispositions: a retained hook or an unenforceable rule without a stated reason is an assertion, … REQUIRED in spirit for classic-hook and prose-only dispositions: a retained hook or an unenforceable rule without a stated reason is an assertion, not a decision.

invariant_ids.$comment: LEGITIMATELY EMPTY for a guard enforcing a rule never written down as an invariant — `destructive_git` and `inplace_edit` are both that case — so empty must never be read as 'enforces nothing'.

InvariantLocator.title: InvariantLocator
InvariantLocator.description: Three-part identity, and the split is the point.

reviewed_digest.description: sha256 of the normalised invariant body, first 16 hex chars.

InvariantLocator.$comment: The ANCHOR (an HTML comment in `do-not.md`) is the semantic identity and survives both renumbering and rewording. The ORDINAL is stored and compared SEPARATELY, so renumbering 7 -> 8 reports LOCATOR_DRIFT rather than silently stealing #8's disposition or following the number. The DIGEST of normalised content forces re-review when the meaning changes. Anchoring was Ray's explicit choice (2026-09-11) over a cheaper heading+hash scheme, accepting that 15 anchor lines spend 15 of do-not.md's 32 remaining budget lines.

enforced_by.$comment: EMPTY is the programme's target list and a real, common answer: measured 2026-09-11 with a control arm, four invariants have zero enforcing modules. Never a gate failure — failing on it would redden the gate for the exact condition the programme exists to fix.

RegistrationState.title: RegistrationState
RegistrationState.description: How far a registration has got toward actually running.
RegistrationState.$comment: FOUR states, not a boolean — because since Claude Code v2.1.195 'enabled' and 'installed' are genuinely different facts, and a boolean collapses them into 'not live' while losing WHICH wall was hit. G00 can determine the first two STATICALLY from committed files and owns them. The last two are G04's (#757) and cannot be established by reading a tree at all. VALUES, each strictly implying the ones before it. declared: the registration exists in a committed file. For a classic hook that is an entry in `.claude/settings.json`; for a function-hook mod it is an `on(...)` call in a tracked `.ts` module. enabled: the configuration that would load it is present — the flag set, and for a mod the plugin named in `extraKnownMarketplaces` + `enabledPlugins`. installed: each machine has run `claude plugin install`; since v2.1.195 an external-source plugin enabled only by PROJECT settings does NOT load without this, so `git clone` alone never arms it. NOT statically determinable. exercised: a real matching event was observed reaching the hook and its verdict attributed to it — the only state that is evidence the thing works, and the only one a dispatched lane can establish. Today `kb-settings-guard` is at `declared`: tracked, complete, and running nothing.
